opening_hook: Kya aap bhi alarm ki snooze se pareshan hain?
narration: Riya ko har subah alarm ki awaaz sunke bhi snooze button dabana aata tha. Ek din usne socha, 'ab bas, roz 5 baje uthungi aur 30 minute yoga karungi.' Pehle hafte mein uski neend kam hui, par usne himmat nahi chhodi. Ek shaam, jab thak kar sofa par baithi, usne apni diary mein likha, 'Aaj maine 10 push‑ups kiye, jo pehle mushkil tha.' Yeh choti jeet uske confidence ko boost kar gayi. Agle din, Riya ne bina alarm ke uthkar jog ki, aur har din thoda aage badhi. Discipline ka yeh chhota step uski zindagi ko steady rhythm de raha hai. Yaad rakho, consistency se hi bade sapne sach hote hain.
story_beats: Hook: Riya snoozes every morning despite the alarm
Problem: She vows to wake at 5 am for 30 minutes of yoga, confronting sleep loss
Conflict: The first week is exhausting, yet she refuses to quit
Turning point: She logs her first 10 push‑ups in her diary, boosting confidence
Resolution: She now rises without an alarm, jogs, and improves daily
Closing message: Discipline and consistency turn small steps into big dreams
